---
title: MIR 1.1.0 direct F200/F210 successor fixture
---

This private fixture consumes only the protected published MIR 1.1.0 F200 source save made by `f200-110-source`. It has distinct F200 and direct F210 Base package wrappers; it does not use an intervening MIR5 F200 save, a Space Age repair route, or a current roster assertion.

Before candidate work, it validates the complete saved 31-row source roster, exact published effect multiset snapshots, earned source recipe bonuses, the worker-robot-battery force contribution, all 42 original startup values, native zero manual-mining fields, foreign queued `.42`, and detached `.27` state. Current-only MIR5 additions remain unearned and outside the historical source roster.

After that read-only preflight, it accelerates and observes exactly one real candidate gear laboratory completion, checks the resulting level and gear bonus, saves once, and requires two cold reloads. The source save hash remains deliberately unbound until the corrected source stage produces it. This fixture is preparation only, not native migration acceptance or a current package result.
